units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left), seconds
background: pure white (255) replacement background; no ground, water, horizon or other features visible

camera.motion: static (rock mask bbox/centroid constant within 1-2 px over all 75 frames)
camera.perspective_cues: none in background (segmented). Boat moves almost parallel to image plane; apparent hull length ~constant (see apparent_size).

boat.description: red-and-white fishing boat with white wheelhouse (red roof), tall mast, hull lettering "AH805"; bow points left
boat.reference_point: ref_x/ref_y = bbox centre of full boat mask (incl. mast) - proxy for rig origin; alternatives in csv: centroid, hull_cx with keel_y (hull bottom)
boat.motion: translates right-to-left across frame the whole clip (frame 0 to 74), slight upward drift in image (keel_y 672 -> 656)
boat.notes: frame 0 clipped at right image edge (bow-to-stern length unreliable there); mast tip is pale and close to the rock bottom edge in early frames so bbox top / height there is +-5 px

rock.description: large pale (cream/brown, dark shadows on right) boulder/cliff-like rock in the upper half of the frame, above the boat
rock.notes: right tip touches the right image edge (x=959), so width may be slightly truncated

events.event: boat already moving left at clip start (no start of motion observed)
boat still moving left at clip end (no stop)
no contact/collision between boat and rock (mast tip passes just below rock bottom edge in early frames)
